HII’s Mission Technologies division is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer for its Uncrewed Systems User Interface team. The role develops and integrates the Odyssey Mission web-based command-and-control application, including React and TypeScript frontends, Java Spring Boot services, and interfaces for unmanned vehicles and external systems.
Defense & Space
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Collaborate with designers, operators, and software and systems engineers to translate mission workflows into intuitive interfaces; use prototypes and user feedback to refine designs and reduce operator workload
Implement and optimize React and TypeScript frontend components and Java Spring Boot backend services for responsive, reliable multi-vehicle operation
Develop REST APIs and WebSocket interfaces for live telemetry, vehicle status, and mission commands, with clear handling of delayed data, connection loss, and errors
Integrate with external applications, vehicle interfaces, and databases such as MongoDB and InfluxDB, using protocols such as DDS (Data Distribution Service)
Write clean, modular, and maintainable code; participate in peer reviews and follow coding standards, secure development practices, and automated build and test workflows
Develop automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. Debug across the UI, backend, network, and hardware interfaces using simulators, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and vehicle testing as needed
Evaluate frontend and backend technologies and practices to improve application usability, performance, and maintainability
Work with product owners and customers to define requirements and acceptance criteria; contribute to Agile planning, demonstrations, and iterative delivery of mission capabilities
Document application changes, API contracts, and integration behavior for frontend, backend, and hardware-facing components
Designs, develops, documents, tests and debugs applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions. Conducts multidisciplinary research and collaborates with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of electronic data processing systems for product and commercial software. Determines computer user needs; analyzes system capabilities to resolve problems on program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques and controls; prepares operating instructions; designs and develops compilers and assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems. Ensures software standards are met
